|errata_history=This is a Playtest version (version 1 of 3, in date order). It is not the current version. The current version is [[BB-8 In Black Squadron 1 (Errata)]] (PC-E1).
* '''Playtest''' (this page, 1 August 2019): Playtest image, published before the set's official release (2 August 2019) and replaced before it. Players Committee card image, 1 August 2019: [[:File:V11-L-bb8inblacksquadron1-20190801.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e26d0f1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/large/bb8inblackone.gif Holotable commit e26d0f1 “Images part 1”]), no mark. Text: “May add 1 pilot. Permanent astromech aboard is •BB-8. If Poe piloting, may lose 1 Force to cancel a just drawn weapon destiny targeting this starship. Immune to attrition &lt; 4.” The title strips print “•BB-8 In Black One”. Published under the file name <code>bb8inblackone.gif</code> with the card title “•BB-8 In Black One” and the art credit “Image approval of Jayson Duria pending”; the file was removed on release day.
* '''Original''' ([[BB-8 In Black Squadron 1]], 2 August 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (2 August 2019). Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-L-bb8inblacksquadron1-20190802.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/60afbbd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/large/bb8inblacksquadron1.gif Holotable commit 60afbbd “Using better graphics”]), no mark. Text: “May add 1 pilot. Permanent astromech aboard is •BB-8. If Poe piloting, may lose 1 Force to cancel a just drawn weapon destiny targeting this starship. Immune to attrition &lt; 4.” '''What changed:''' before release: the title “•BB-8 In Black One” became “•BB-8 In Black Squadron 1” (new file name &lt;code&gt;bb8inblacksquadron1.gif&lt;/code&gt;); the art credit “Image approval of Jayson Duria pending” became “Image courtesy of Jayson Duria”; re-rendered with sharper graphics; same game text.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[BB-8 In Black Squadron 1 (Errata)]], 29 March 2023): Players Committee card image, 29 March 2023: [[:File:V11-L-bb8inblacksquadron1.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/168657a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/hires/bb8inblacksquadron1.png Holotable commit 168657a “Set 11 Remastered”]), no mark. Text: “May add 1 pilot. Permanent astromech aboard is •BB-8. If Poe piloting, may lose 1 Force to cancel a just drawn weapon destiny targeting this starship. Immune to attrition &lt; 4.” '''What changed:''' Set 11 remaster: same words; new artwork (image courtesy of Edoardo Grimaldi, was Jayson Duria); re-rendered at high resolution.
